manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Sakashima either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{U} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Sakashima enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Sakashima leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Mirror Image returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Sakashima.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Sakashima until Mirror Image leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Sakashima leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mirror Image until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, Sakashima returns to the battlefield from exile as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.
